name: SDH1-versus-O-NBO-strict-resource-pair

comparison_scope: Same supported legal normal S1 hit/read/write classes, source snapshot, original AR allocator, real guards, one PTW, one fast result, publication/retirement adapter and invalidation scope. Logical pairing is constructive and conditional on those interfaces being implemented; it is not native safety acceptance.

symbols.T: S+K+G; bank can be derived from immutable full source bit2 in the frozen ID0/4/8/12 integration
symbols.C_common: All identical original modules, datapath buffering, cache/PTW/walk/fault handling, AXI ordering/credits, software/application resources below; not zero

pair.notes: Replace/expose same original cells; do not retain old8 plus allocate new8. Full source already lives in raw AXI ID, no second percell full header.

pair.candidate: Original Q full raw AR headers unchanged; one existing N OUT stores PA/permissions/T and reads original tagged cell directly until physical AR accept
pair.ordinary: same direct OUT, no percell PA or READY permission writeback
pair.notes: Root paired adapter. Normal TC PA remains independent; normal completion and fast OUT coexist with same priority/locks. Optional prepared union Q*max(H_raw_AR+M_raw,H_physical_AR+M_ready) is available to both but not charged as mandatory direct-path state.

pair.candidate: C_AR_live_and_owner(Q)+Q*(G+J) or same proved serial-job derived encoding
pair.ordinary: same encoding and same legal field reuse
pair.notes: No request carries job/cursor natively. Root source proof may derive per-source identity; otherwise store and charge it. Direct OUT has no percell READY permissions; owner/live/slot-reuse state remains paid.

pair.candidate: same Q-slot allocator and per-fullsource oldest selector
pair.ordinary: same; concrete ring+tombstone can avoid rank array
pair.notes: Ring holes are not reused until head-prefix retirement in the conservative encoding. Any immediate-hole reuse allocator, order fields, generation checks and fairness cost apply to both. No free FIFO interior views.

pair.candidate: req width117+T; full resp184+T if native structs retained
pair.notes: Each retained/spilled owner copy is charged at its actual multiplicity. Native bank1 is replaced, not double-counted; all source/slot/gen fields stay live until true handoff. Wire width and state FF width are separate.

pair.candidate: one existing N req/DC/DDTP snapshot, widened tag and paid capture
pair.notes: DDTC and IOTLB checked against this request. Cannot borrow active miss DC/PC. Multiplicity stays one.

pair.candidate: one existing N full resp184+T plus OUT state; or common compact same-supported-result encoding
pair.ordinary: same one slot and same encoding
pair.notes: No extra result buffer hidden in return route. OUT itself holds PA/permissions until selected physical AR acceptance; root direct path has no percell READY union. Compact result is legal for both, not candidate-only.

pair.candidate: T equality/valid/gen guard, selected full raw AR header read and OUT-to-physical-AR mux
pair.notes: Native bank-only route cannot be reused as though it already identifies two simultaneous samebank owners. No AR-cell result writeport is needed by common direct OUT.

pair.candidate: paid query/physical-offer header reads, input capture write and selective cell removal/allocator metadata updates
pair.notes: Single time-multiplexed query read is allowed for both; scanning four heads is not four simultaneous free cache lookups. Separate OUT capture reuses existing N result register; no percell PA response writeback in this pair. Addressed valid/age/gen updates and conflict control still paid.

pair.candidate: one existing real N DDTC/IOTLB time-shared lane and exact normal/fast/invalid arbitration
pair.notes: No second cache bank/way/walker/lookup port; successful formal accept touches once; rejected probe no touch.

pair.candidate: C_owner(S,J)+actual externalAW identity/accept event and live W head association
pair.notes: Current bank owner33bit native guard is not this certificate. Any new owner tap/event storage/input wire is explicit for both; virtualAW/firstVALID/internalspill is insufficient.

L=4096 in whole-page workflow permits13bit byte cursor or10bit beat cursor per live tracked position; multiplicity and existing-counter reuse must come from root source proof. Same-job later read is insufficient.

pair.candidate: C_preceding_sources_and_completion plus paid trustworthy independence proof
pair.notes: Buffered WLAST is not target consumption; can reuse native completed-owner pointers only with precise handoff evidence.

pair.candidate: 1 grant_used bit plus normal-walk lifetime reset control
pair.notes: Set on actual hit admission, not choose/probe; no unbounded hit priority starvation.
No recomputation may withdraw liveVALID; invalidation wins before new accept, existing owned work follows same protocol. Scope beyond the root prototype is not proved here.

pair.candidate: current-source/job compare, oldest eligibility, legal hit/guard and required-byte predicate
pair.notes: Unique W owner and source oldest remove extra RR/age ordering from O-NBO. Both may synthesize the same mux/comparator Boolean network.

Includes original AW/W/R/B FIFOs/spills, credits/full-ID maps, error sinks, cached permissions, normalPTW/fill/faults, existing two4KiB buffers/other24B buffers, iDMA meta and task publication/consumer ownership; none counted as free.

pair.candidate: same task registration/guard certificates and actual completion verification
pair.notes: CPU time, wiring/control API, task metadata and application cost are payable; values not measured.

logical_verdict.reason_aggregate_unknown: Job/cursor/owner and allocator exact source realization is root/source-seat work; partial bit formula must not pretend complete measured implementation.
logical_verdict.cost_identity: C_SDH1=C_O-NBO for the root common direct-OUT adapter, same chosen primitives, original raw-header lifetimes, tag multiplicities, ports, observation taps and schedule; common unknowns remain identical symbols.
logical_verdict.not_claimed: No minimum-area bound, publication coverage, native production safety, timing closure or measured hardware delta. An independently specified materially cheaper candidate implementation would require a new actual paired comparator, not just unknown physical values.

software_swap_pair.frozen_action: DMA0 old(A)->B and DMA1 old(B)->A; preserve exact physical A/B addresses and actual old byte values
software_swap_pair.common_control: Both exact4096B source complete receipts, original buffer owners, fixed job/gen/source/destination binding, permissions/fault behavior, native W/B completion and consumer receipt
software_swap_pair.ordinary_program: Close both AW pre-VALID gates before launch; start two original normal copies; after both complete4096B R safely stored, open gates; wait full W/B/consumer completion; release owners.
software_swap_pair.hardware_vs_software_state: Same two-phase logical control can run in software only if synchronous/stable paid gates and completion interfaces are software accessible. Software polling/MMIO latency and hardware controller LUT/Fmax remain null; no claim physically same cost.
software_swap_pair.native_unproven: READ_ONLY/WRITE_ONLY ttype use scalar rdata/wdata regs, not two independent original4096B buffer phases; native normal AW fall-through and frontend job launch do not establish the required API.
software_swap_pair.root_new_source_handoff: Per-backend AW fallthrough1slot plus shared AWspill2slot. Default coupled cannot generate secondAR after gate because w_ready blocks. Existing CONF.decouple=1 enables independent R/W: firstAW held perDMA, secondAW remains mutable legalizer, two256beat ARs may complete into each buffer. Requires paid gate before source-mux firstAWVALID and empty oldWtokens. Conditional source-derived reachability, not native execution or existing software gate API.
software_swap_pair.extra_scratch_variant: CPU scratch or DMA-to-memory temporary copies change data storage/traffic/control path and must be costed separately, not claimed strict same8192B internal-buffer reproduction.
software_swap_pair.actual_native_interface_verdict: deferred to source seat/root exact call chain
